calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-24-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an adult and Three Minors.
Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Gena Eales.
Petitioners: Linh Phuong Nguyen Dang present in pro per and as Guardian ad litem for Three Minors: Patina Minh Phuong Thao Le, Khristina Dang Ung and Sidney Dang Ung, was swron and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the Petition for the Petitioner for change of name to: Leorah Rebekah Dang.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Tzipporah Patina Dang, Yekarah Ashirah Dang and Ezrah Zechariah Dang.
Decree signed in open court.

decreed_name: Leorah Rebekah Dang; Tzipporah Patina Dang
